description: Right hand: finger gun held upright, palm square to the camera, thumb up (2-5.7 s); then tilted away from the camera with the thumb still up (6.4-24.3 s), where the thumb foreshortens and its tip shows near the middle of the palm: 3D thumb-out measures read it as dropped (0.1-0.4), but in the image it stays 0.44 or more knuckle widths from the index knuckle; then upright again with five trigger pulls, thumb tip down by the index knuckle (0.34-0.38 knuckle widths) (26.2-33.4 s). A wobble at 25.2 s turns the palm for a frame. Recorded from a live webcam at 640x480 via HandwaveWidget.hands_data (~49 fps); timestamps are when Python received each frame; labels are as the tracker sees them.
